title: Rotating scanned PDFs: a step-by-step guide
excerpt: Rotate every page, or use an explicit extract-and-reassemble workflow when only one scanned page is sideways.
author: The MY PDF FIX Team
body:
## Check whether every page needs the same rotation

Open the original PDF and inspect several pages, including any landscape pages. PDF Fix Hub's [Rotate PDF](/rotate-pdf) applies one rotation to every page in the selected file. It does not offer a per-page selection or automatic orientation detection.

Keep the original. Rotation changes page orientation without deliberately converting the page content into images, but saving creates a rewritten PDF. Preserve a signed original separately because a rewrite can invalidate its digital signature.

## Rotate a whole document

1. Open [Rotate PDF](/rotate-pdf) and add the PDF.
2. Choose **90° clockwise**, **180°**, or **270° clockwise**. The last option is the same turn as 90° counter-clockwise.
3. Click **Process**, then **Download**.
4. Open the saved copy and check the first, middle and last pages, plus any page with a different layout.

Choose the turn that would make the top of the text face upward. If every page is upside down, choose 180°. If you choose the wrong direction, start again with the original rather than repeatedly modifying successive copies.

## Example: fix only page two of a four-page PDF

For a small document, the following workflow avoids rotating the other pages. It assumes only original page two needs a 90° clockwise turn.

1. In [Extract Pages](/extract-pdf-pages), extract `2` and download that one-page PDF.
2. In [Rotate PDF](/rotate-pdf), rotate the extracted file 90° clockwise and download it.
3. In [Remove Pages](/remove-pdf-pages), open the original four-page PDF and remove `2`. Download the remaining three pages; their original identities are 1, 3 and 4.
4. In [Merge PDF](/merge-pdf), add that three-page file first and the corrected one-page file second. The merged order is now original pages 1, 3, 4, 2.
5. In [Reorder Pages](/reorder-pdf-pages), use `1,4,2,3` on the merged file. These are its current positions, not the original page labels. Download the result.
6. Check that the final PDF has four pages in original order, with only page two turned. Compare each page with the original so that none is missing or duplicated.

This is an illustrative workflow, not a claim that your file has been tested. For many differently rotated pages, a dedicated editor with selective rotation may be more practical.

## Rotation does not repair every scan problem

A small tilt within a scan is skew, which a 90° turn will not straighten. Rotation also does not sharpen blurry text, recognize scanned words or remove shadows. [Adjust PDF Brightness](/adjust-pdf-brightness) can change brightness and contrast, but it rasterizes the output and removes selectable text and interactive features. Keep a separate original before trying that adjustment.

If a viewer shows an unexpected orientation, reopen the downloaded file and check it in the viewer the recipient will use. Review print preview as well as the on-screen page.
